title: tightest iteration, 50 trials
reason: The same idea pushed further: up to 50 trials and a 0.001 mm head tolerance. On EPA SWMM 5.2.4 this does best on the wet-bed dam break (A1F-011), the hydraulic jump (A1F-020) and the steady channel A1D-003, but slightly worse than 30 trials on the dry-bed dam break. Both set-ups are published so the trade-off is visible.
